system.boundary: Build a causal wave-powered reverse-osmosis desalination system.
engineering_objects: Build a causal wave-powered reverse-osmosis desalination system.
Couple an oscillating wave-energy flap to a hydraulic cylinder and directional-valve circuit.

The pressurized seawater path must include energy storage/pressure smoothing, a reverse-osmosis membrane that separates permeate and brine, and a pressure-exchanger recovery path that feeds recovered brine energy back into the seawater circuit.
